topic: Demonstration and explanation on the various GSEs required on dispersal for flying activity and flight servicing, GSE maintenance.
syllabus_extract: Demonstration and explanation on the various GSEs required on dispersal for flying activity and flight servicing, GSE maintenance. Schedule & record of inspections carried out, Calibration of GSE (as applicable) and record of calibration.
specific_objectives: 21.1.8.1 Trainee will be able explain various GSEs required on dispersal for flying activity and flight servicing.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of GSE identification, inspection record verification, and calibration log review under instructor supervision.
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of Ground Support Equipment (GSE)?
List three essential GSE items required for aircraft dispersal.
Why is calibration of GSE critical for flight safety?

development.content:
Aircraft Tugs and Loaders
Power Units and Generators
Hydraulic and Pneumatic Systems
Fuel Servicing Equipment
Aircraft Loading and Unloading

GSE Maintenance Schedules
Inspection Record Keeping
Calibration Procedures and Logs
Defect Reporting Protocols
Storage and Security Measures

Hands-on GSE Inspection
Logbook Entry Practice
Calibration Verification Check
Defect Identification Drill
Equipment Storage Drill

summary_questions: Explain the difference between a scheduled inspection and an unscheduled defect check.
Describe the steps involved in verifying GSE calibration records.
What are the immediate actions required if a GSE defect is found during dispersal?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on the specific GSE requirements for the next scheduled flying activity, referencing the maintenance schedule.
